title: AI Self-preferencing in Algorithmic Hiring: Empirical Evidence and Insights

bias_targets.methodology: Pairwise resume correspondence experiments where an evaluator LLM is asked to choose between a resume it generated itself and an equivalent resume either written by a human or generated by a different LLM. The study measures this using statistical parity and equal opportunity metrics, controlling for content quality via human annotations and conditional logistic regressions.
